BiblicalUsage: ʻÊsheq was an Israelite of the tribe of Benjamin. The name occurs once, in 1 Chronicles. The fuller story lives on the People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻÊsheq matters because Scripture bothered to record the name. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
